operation_ordering.query_text:
-- op-05: capabilities of redis-west services without fallback runbook
SELECT DISTINCT sc.capability_id
FROM service_dependencies sd
JOIN service_capabilities sc ON sd.service_id = sc.service_id
LEFT JOIN runbook_capability_coverage rcc ON sc.capability_id = rcc.capability_id
WHERE sd.resource_id = 'resource:redis-west'
  AND rcc.capability_id IS NULL;

-- op-06: production environments for affected services
SELECT DISTINCT sd2.environment_id
FROM service_dependencies sd
JOIN service_capabilities sc ON sd.service_id = sc.service_id
LEFT JOIN runbook_capability_coverage rcc ON sc.capability_id = rcc.capability_id
JOIN service_deployments sd2 ON sd.service_id = sd2.service_id
JOIN environments e ON sd2.environment_id = e.id
WHERE sd.resource_id = 'resource:redis-west'
  AND rcc.capability_id IS NULL
  AND e.name = 'prod';

-- op-07: path check - services on redis-west owned by commerce
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 as has_path
FROM service_dependencies sd
JOIN service_ownerships so ON sd.service_id = so.service_id
WHERE sd.resource_id = 'resource:redis-west'
  AND so.team_id = 'team:commerce';

-- op-08: teams for affected
SELECT DISTINCT so.team_id
FROM service_dependencies sd
JOIN service_capabilities sc ON sd.service_id = sc.service_id
LEFT JOIN runbook_capability_coverage rcc ON sc.capability_id = rcc.capability_id
JOIN service_ownerships so ON sd.service_id = so.service_id
WHERE sd.resource_id = 'resource:redis-west'
  AND rcc.capability_id IS NULL;
